title: Recover deterministically from transcript history protocol errors
outcome: The history-page request path reports protocolError outcomes as a toast but does not invalidate the resident window or schedule an authoritative bounded resync. The user can remain on stale or incompatible transcript state after a server/client paging contract mismatch.
acceptance: A history protocol error produces one deterministic recovery outcome: invalidate the affected paging authority and perform a bounded tail/state resync, or transition to an explicit retryable error state. Avoid recovery loops and duplicate requests. Add coverage for protocol error during older, newer, start, and tail demands as applicable.
